rows.label: tlk70000022_05_msg0001
rows.name:
...Rita and I had a fight. It may have
been the first time we ever argued.

rows.label: tlk70000022_05_msg0002
rows.name:
She insisted on staying in Iira
to help out, but I told her
straight - we don't need her.

rows.label: tlk70000022_05_msg0003
rows.name:
I don't believe my choice is wrong.
Whatever happens, I'm staying in Iira.

rows.label: tlk70000022_05_msg0004
rows.name:
But I can't keep dragging that girl
into the way I've chosen to live.

rows.label: tlk70000022_05_msg0005
rows.name:
She has her own goal. She said she
wants to become a Driver like
Laura-sama.

rows.label: tlk70000022_05_msg0006
rows.name:
...That won't happen if she stays
here. It's time for her to truly set
out.
